reason: training_data.json is a pairwise reranker label set, not a full-corpus retrieval qrel file with source text. MiniLM Hit@K/MRR would require cloning unlabeled Flask/FastAPI/Click snapshots and treating unjudged symbols as non-relevant, which would not be a defensible baseline. No labels were invented or edited.

dataset.label_creation: Appears hand-labeled: each query has one positive function whose name/doc-adjacent role matches the question, plus three easy negatives (often sibling functions in the same example file).

suitability.future_reranker_pairwise_training: Possible after pinning repository revisions and resolving (file, chunk_name) to current AST symbols. Do not train until that mapping is verified.
suitability.maps_to_phase2_ast_types: Not as stored. Labels use FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef rather than function/async_function/method/async_method, and have no qualified_name.

phase5_query_split.method: Query-level split. Every example with the same query string stays in one split. Queries sorted alphabetically within repository, then sliced. Seed is unused because the split is lexicographic, not random.
phase5_query_split.rule: Train and tune the reranker only on train+validation. Report MiniLM vs MiniLM+reranker only on test. Never use test queries for training or hyperparameter search.
